sobre.title: about me
story: Video has always been my way of telling stories. I started editing at 16, when I created Spencive, my clothing brand. I needed videos to show the pieces, and I learned by doing, from script to final cut.
The brand became my school. I took from it the care of someone who manages a business and its content, and the drive to deliver work I'm proud of.
Today I'm a videomaker and editor. I shoot and edit vertical video for fashion brands, events and festivals, and I work with clients all over Brazil as a remote editor.
